author: Will
description: Assign regular-member and booster rewards based on equipped Discord Server Tags and current server boosts, with full read-only role permission snapshots and permission-change comparisons.
short: Tiered tag and booster roles with permission audit
end_user_data_statement: Stores per-guild reward role IDs, an optional basic eligibility role ID, enabled state, and an administrator-requested snapshot of role permission bits and channel-level role overwrites. No member-specific data is persisted.
